13. The actual work and services carried out by China Status through its directors in connection with the Wang Fuk Court Renovation can be categorised as follows:

(i) Submitting SDNs to the FSD

14. PC&E would either in writing through the WhatsApp group mentioned above or by telephone, inform me that they would be commencing work on the fire services water tank of a building, and require China Status to submit an SDN to the FSD for the FH / HR system of that building.

15. I would prepare and fill in and sign the SDNs, then pass them to another director of China Status, Mr. Yim Choi Wah Alex (“Mr. Yim”) for endorsement of the form FS 251, then I would submit the SDNs to the FSD, usually by facsimile transmission. The FH / HR system of the corresponding building would then be suspended. According to my recollection, the SDNs submitted for each of the 8 buildings all sought suspensions of the respective FH / HR Systems by 14 days.

16. Below is a list of the dates I submitted the SDNs to the FSD in respect of the 8 buildings of Wang Fuk Court:

On or around 7th April 2025:  
Wang Tai House and Wang Chi House

On or around 16th May 2025:  
Wang Kin House

On or around 16th June 2025:  
Wang Shing House

On or around 4th July 2025:  
Wang Sun House

On or around 11th July 2025:  
Wang Tao House

On or around 4th September 2025:  
Wang Cheong House and Wang Yan House

(ii) Applying to the FSD for extensions of shutdown of FH / HR Systems

17. If PC&E required an extension of the suspension of the FH / HR System of any building for their work on its fire service water tank, they would inform me and China Status would apply to the FSD for an extension in respect of that building. To the best of my recollection, all extensions submitted were for a further 14 days, the same period as the initial suspension. Pursuant to the representations of PC&E that the remedial works on the fire service water tank were still in progress, we duly submitted extension applications for the continued shutdown of FH/HR
